draft_text: Tessaline appears to slightly outperform Varrow-NMT in BLEU on the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set (28.4 vs 27.6 over 8 seeds).
revised_text: Tessaline outperforms Varrow-NMT in BLEU on the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set (28.4 vs 27.6 over 8 seeds).
rationale: T1.r1.bleu (28.4±0.6) vs T1.r2.bleu (27.6±0.8) show a mean difference. The sentence's hedge "appears to slightly" is not contradicted, but the evidence supports an unhedged difference claim within the tested scope. The "slightly" qualifier is not supported by any test.
